messages.en: I just got back from One Asia Festival…
The weather today is seriously hot.
It's been a while since I've sweat this much.
You really have to be careful with the weather these days.
Don't blast the air conditioner just because it's hot.
Everyone's getting sick and having a hard time ㅠㅠ
I'm Strong Hayeon, so I'm okay.
I've stored up body fat to survive the summer.
Now I just have to use it all as energy.
ㅋㅎㄹㅋㄹㅋㄹㅋㅋㅎㅋㄹㅋㄹ
I told you I don't work out, right?

messages.ko: 근데 오늘 행사 오랜만에 가서 땀 뻘뻘 흘리니까
messages.en: But today, after going to an event for the first time in a while and sweating a lot,
it felt so good.
It made me think I should start going to the gym.
...Even though I know I won't ㅎㅎ
The reason I don't exercise is...

messages.ko: 좀만 하면 모든 사람 엎어치기 가능해질것같음
messages.en: I feel like if I worked out even a little, I'd be able to throw everyone over my shoulder.

messages.ko: 세상에서 가장 무거운 돌 이런거 거뜬히 들것같이 생겨짐
messages.en: I'd probably end up looking like I could casually lift the heaviest rock in the world.
Oh right, and...
The Summer Vacation Signal came out.

messages.ko: 분명 실제로 봤을땐 소년미 가득 여름 여름 숏헤어
messages.en: When I saw myself in real life, I thought I looked like a youthful, summery short-haired girl.

messages.ko: 이런 느낌이얐는데 삽살개가 자꾸 말해서 놀랐어
messages.en: But everyone kept saying I looked like a Sapsal dog, so I was surprised.
You were grilling the meat really hard though.
Exactly!

messages.ko: 우리 테이블에 고기 잘 굽는시람리 없어서
messages.en: There wasn't anyone at our table who was good at grilling meat,
so I basically rescued all the meat myself.
But they didn't show that.
They only uploaded the clips where I looked cool and sexy.
I'm kind of sad.
Nobody paid attention to it...
No way...
There's no way...
Oh, and also...
I wasn't even wearing a swimsuit,
but the members grabbed me and attacked me,
and they didn't show that either.
My sacrifice was for nothing...
Chaeyeon unnie held me down,
and Kim Soomin just...
attacked me with a water gun.
I cleaned out my gallery this time,
and uploaded all the pretty photos.
Wait for them~
There are twin-tail photos too!!
Anyway, it's been a while since I've been in Busan,
so I'm really excited.
Oh right.
Fromm is disappearing soon.

messages.ko: 여기 남겨놓은 메세지 이제 다 못본다니…
messages.en: That means we won't be able to read all the messages I've left here anymore...
Ah, I thought that was a crying emoji.
Wait.
Oh right, it's sweat. Perfect for Hayeon today ㄹㅋㅋㄹㄹㅋ
Once all the uploaded photos are up,

messages.ko: 아 코스모 그것도 프사 할수 있겠지!??
messages.en: Ah, we'll be able to use them as profile pictures on Cosmo too, right?!
...We have absolutely no information right now.
Me neither.
ㅋㄹㅋㄹㄹㄹㅋ
I don't know~
Recommend me dinner!!!!
Since you're in Busan, go with dwaeji gukbap.
Actually... I want grilled shellfish.

messages.ko: 오늘 멘트 즉석에서 나온거야?? 알려조 ㅋㅋㅋㅋ
messages.en: Did you come up with today's stage comments on the spot?? Tell us ㅋㅋㅋㅋ
Yep, it was improvised ㅋㅅㅋㅅㅋ
"I'm Hayeon, who loves a hearty bowl of gukbap."
Apparently there's another good gukbap place later too.
Secret~
Now I'm gonna go eat well~
See you on Cosmo....
Haranghae~~
Soomin's next to me ㅋㅎㅋㅎㅋ
Byeee!
